output.executive_summary: Fix the reflected XSS on /search and /help first; it is the only confirmed High with direct evidence and a 30-day FedRAMP window. The High SQL injection is very likely a false positive on a static CSS file and needs a manual retest before any POA&M entry. The Moderate header and jQuery findings can ship together in one hardening change. Low findings are quick nginx and cookie configuration fixes.

poam_rows.remediation: Confirm with a manual retest (sqlmap or a parameterized request) against the static asset; if not reproducible, document as a false positive with the retest output attached.
poam_rows.ticket_summary: Probable false positive: boolean SQLi flagged on static CSS query param 'v'; requires manual retest before POA&M entry.

poam_rows.remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding in the search and help templates, add server-side allow-list validation for q and topic, and add a Content-Security-Policy that blocks inline script.
poam_rows.ticket_summary: Reflected XSS on /search (q) and /help (topic); payload echoed unencoded. Fix via output encoding + input validation.

poam_rows.weakness: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
poam_rows.remediation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header at the nginx layer starting with default-src 'self' in report-only mode, then enforce after one week of reports.
poam_rows.ticket_summary: CSP header missing on 14 responses; add baseline CSP at nginx.

poam_rows.remediation: Set Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors 'none' (or X-Frame-Options DENY) on all authenticated and login pages.
Upgrade jQuery to the current supported release, run the UI regression suite, and add dependency scanning to CI so outdated libraries fail the build.
poam_rows.ticket_summary: Outdated jQuery 1.12.4 served from /static/js; upgrade and add CI dependency scan.

poam_rows.remediation: Set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict on session_id in the auth middleware and verify with a response-header test.
poam_rows.ticket_summary: session_id cookie missing Secure flag on /login.

poam_rows.weakness: Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field
poam_rows.remediation: Set server_tokens off in nginx.conf and redeploy; confirm the header no longer contains a version string.
poam_rows.ticket_summary: nginx version exposed in Server header; set server_tokens off.
